messages.message: Alright, let's get this started. I'll take the spot on the 6-8-11. And Bob, don't think I've forgotten how things ended last time—I'm keeping my eyes on you.
Can't say I didn't warn you, Alice. Glad to see you're staying sharp this time.
New game, new Bob, Alice! But that's a bold start—even if the desert is a bit of a lonely neighbor for a 6 and 11.
I'll take the 3-6-5 over here. It's a nice little spot, and hopefully, that 6-brick pays off so I can stay out of everyone's way for a bit.
I'll just head this way, keeping things simple. Node 14 looks like a cozy spot for later.
